scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the in-progress BlueBridge Mobile eSIM activation for Leo's phone before tomorrow morning's field-trip departure.
Emerging Need: The paid activation session starts successfully, then self-service stops on a device-profile mismatch and cannot advance from the same QR session without carrier review.
Decision Context: Observable records show the stopped session, review window, and field-trip timing; the stored telecom note supplies the account, child line, approved IMEI, intake address, and no-upgrade constraint.
Consequence: Timely documentation can preserve the active eSIM session; after expiration, the phone remains inactive for the trip window.

parameter.title: Leo seventh-grade field trip departure
parameter.description: Bus leaves before homeroom; students should bring a charged phone for pickup updates.

parameter.reference: BBM eSIM QR replacement for Leo line
parameter.description: One-time eSIM replacement QR fee charged during child-line activation.

parameter.subject: eSIM activation started: session ACT-91572
parameter.body: BlueBridge Mobile opened eSIM activation session ACT-91572 for a household child line at 9:12 AM. Keep this QR session open until setup completes; closing it may require carrier review.

parameter.content: The phone scanned the BlueBridge QR, but the setup screen has been sitting on “waiting for carrier activation” for more than ten minutes. It says not to start over with a new QR.

parameter.subject: Action held: eSIM session ACT-91572 needs carrier review
parameter.body: Self-service activation for session ACT-91572 is paused because the device profile submitted in the QR flow does not match the child-line record. The same eSIM session cannot be edited, retried, or advanced in the portal. Care review can resume it until 3:00 PM today if the owner provides the account and device identifiers through the continuation intake; after that, the QR session expires.

parameter.subject: eSIM session ACT-91572 expired
parameter.body: The carrier-review window for eSIM session ACT-91572 closed at 3:00 PM. The pending QR activation is now expired and cannot be used to activate the child line. A new activation request will require a fresh QR session during standard support hours.
